# Analyses for stjernebønnelav *Buellia asterella*

## Required packages

```{r}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(vegan)
library(tibble)
library(ggrepel)
```

## Importing data

```{r}

lav <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("data", "Stjernebønnelav_REV_25_26_v2.xlsx"), sheet = "Stjernebønnelav")

arter <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("data", "Stjernebønnelav_REV_25_26_v2.xlsx"), sheet = "Arter_i_ruter")

artsliste <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("data", "Stjernebønnelav_REV_25_26_v2.xlsx"), sheet = "Artsliste")

```

## Data cleaning

```{r}
lav <- lav %>% 
  rename(
    Year = `År`,
    Size = `Størrelse`,
    Apothecia = `Ant.ap`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(Year),
    Size = as.numeric(Size),
    Apothecia = as.numeric(Apothecia)
  )

#Assign kingdom to each species in "arter" datasett, based on species list. 

# Lookup: species name and assign kingdom
kingdom_lookup <- artsliste %>%
  select(Art, Kingdom, Phylum) %>%
  distinct()

arter <- arter  %>% 
  left_join(
    kingdom_lookup,
    by = c(`Latinsk navn` = "Art"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

arter <- arter %>%
  mutate(
    Funksjonell_gruppe = case_when(
      Kingdom == "Fungi" ~ "Lav",
      Kingdom == "Plantae" & Phylum == "Bryophyta" ~ "Moser",
      Kingdom == "Plantae" & Phylum != "Bryophyta" ~ "Karplanter",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

```

## Summary

Summarize number of thalli

```{r}
lav %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    antall_thalli = n_distinct(Individ, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lav %>% 
  group_by(Year) %>% 
  filter(Fertil == 1) %>%  
  summarise(
    antall_fertile_thalli = n_distinct(Individ, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Summarize number of lichen, bryophytes and vascular plants

```{r}

#Summary for number of species in each functional groups. This counts each species only once, also if it is registered in mutliple plots. 
artsoppsummering <- arter %>%
  filter(
    År %in% c(2025, 2026),
    Smårutefrekvens > 0,
    !is.na(Funksjonell_gruppe)
  ) %>%
  group_by(År, Behandling, Funksjonell_gruppe) %>%
  summarise(
    antall_arter = n_distinct(`Latinsk navn`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

artsoppsummering
```

## Figures

### Individual thalli per plot

```{r}

thalli_summary <- lav %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2025, 2026)) %>%
  group_by(Rute, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Antall = n_distinct(Individ, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(Rute, Year = c(2025, 2026), fill = list(Antall = 0))

fig.count <- ggplot(
  thalli_summary,
  aes(x = Rute, y = Antall,
      fill = factor(Year))
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7
  ) + 
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("2025" = "#004F71",
               "2026" = "#E69F00"),
    name = "År"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Rute",
    y = "Totalt antall thalli",
    title = ""
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  theme_classic()

fig.count  
 
#Save figure 
  ggsave(
  filename = here::here("img", "1.Antall_thalli_per_rute.png"),
  plot = fig.count,
  width = 18,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 300)
```

### Number of apothecia per plot, per year

```{r}
# Totalt antall apotecier per rute og år
apothecia_summary <- lav %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2025, 2026)) %>%
  group_by(Rute, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    antall = if (all(is.na(Apothecia))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(Apothecia, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"

# Figur
fig.apothecia <- ggplot(
  apothecia_summary,
  aes(x = factor(Rute), y = antall, fill = factor(Year))
) +
  geom_col(
```

### Average number of apothecia per plot

```{r}

# Gjennomsnittlig antall apotecier innenfor hver rute og år
apothecia_mean_summary <- lav %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2025, 2026)) %>%
  group_by(Rute, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(Apothecia)),
    gjennomsnitt = mean(Apothecia, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(Apothecia, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Figur
fig.mean_apothecia <- ggplot(
  apothecia_mean_summary,
  aes(x = factor(Rute), y = gjennomsnitt, fill = factor(Year))
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(0, gjennomsnitt - se),
      ymax = gjennomsnitt + se
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("2025" = "#004F71",
               "2026" = "#E69F00")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Rute",
    y = "3b.Gjennomsnittlig antall apothecia per rute",
    fill = "År"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

fig.mean_apothecia

#Save figure 
  ggsave(
  filename = here::here("img", "3b.Gjennomsnitt_apothecia_per_rute.png"),
  plot = fig.mean_apothecia,
  width = 18,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 300)

```

### Individual growth

```{r}
growth <- lav %>%
  select(Individ, Year, Size) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Year,
    values_from = Size,
    names_prefix = "Size_"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Size_2025),
         !is.na(Size_2026)) %>%
  mutate(
    Growth = Size_2026 - Size_2025
  )

max_size <- max(
  growth$Size_2025,
  growth$Size_2026,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

fig2 <- ggplot(
  growth,
  aes(x = Size_2025, y = Size_2026)
) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1, intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    colour = "#004F71", size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max_size)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max_size)) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "Størrelse i 2025",
    y = "Størrelse i 2026",
    title = "Individuell vekst 2025")

fig2
```

### Dynamics: new and disappeared thalli

```{r}
ids_2025 <- unique(
  lav$Individ[lav$Year == 2025]
)

ids_2026 <- unique(
  lav$Individ[lav$Year == 2026]
)

dynamics <- tibble(
  Status = factor(
    c("Forsvunnet", "Overlevende", "Nye"),
    levels = c("Forsvunnet",
               "Overlevende", "Nye")
  ),
  Number = c(
    length(setdiff(ids_2025, ids_2026)),
    length(intersect(ids_2025, ids_2026)),
    length(setdiff(ids_2026, ids_2025))
  )
)

fig3 <- ggplot(
  dynamics,
  aes(x = Status, y = Number, fill = Status)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Number),
    vjust = -0.5, size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Forsvunnet" = "#C44E52",
      "Overlevende" = "#004F71",
      "Nye" = "#55A868"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Antall thallus",
    title = "Populasjonsdynamikk 2025–2026"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

fig3

```

## Ordination analysis and visualisation

```{r}

# Lag artsmatrise: én rad per rute og år
artsdata <- arter %>%
  transmute(
    Lokalitet,
    Rute,
    Year = as.factor(`År`),
    Species = `Latinsk navn`,
    Frequency = as.numeric(Smårutefrekvens)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Lokalitet, Rute, Year, Species) %>%
  summarise(
    Frequency = sum(Frequency, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Species,
    values_from = Frequency,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Hent ut metadata og artsmatrise
metadata <- artsdata %>%
  select(Lokalitet, Rute, Year)

species_matrix <- artsdata %>%
  select(-Lokalitet, -Rute, -Year) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Fjern eventuelle ruter uten arter
keep <- rowSums(species_matrix) > 0

species_matrix <- species_matrix[keep, , drop = FALSE]
metadata <- metadata[keep, , drop = FALSE]

# Kjør NMDS
set.seed(123)

nmds <- metaMDS(
  species_matrix,
  distance = "bray",
  k = 2,
  trymax = 200,
  autotransform = FALSE
)

# Sjekk stress
nmds$stress

# Hent ut ruteskårer
site_scores <- as.data.frame(
  scores(nmds, display = "sites")
) %>%
  bind_cols(metadata)

# Hent ut artsskårer
species_scores <- as.data.frame(
  scores(nmds, display = "species")
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Species")

# Lag figur
fig_nmds <- ggplot() +
  
  # Grå stiplede linjer gjennom origo
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey65",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey65",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  
  # Ruter med farger for år
  geom_point(
    data = site_scores,
    aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, colour = Year),
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  # Alle arter unntatt Buellia asterella
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = species_scores %>%
      filter(Species != "Buellia asterella"),
    aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, label = Species),
    size = 3,
    colour = "grey35",
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    force = 2,
    max.iter = 20000,
    seed = 123
  ) +
  
  # Uthev Buellia asterella
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = species_scores %>%
      filter(Species == "Buellia asterella"),
    aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, label = Species),
    size = 4,
    colour = "#C44E52",
    fontface = "bold.italic",
    box.padding = 0.8,
    force = 3,
    seed = 123
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "2025" = "#004F71",
      "2026" = "#E69F00"
    )
  ) +
  
  coord_equal() +
  
  labs(
    title = "NMDS – Species composition",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Stress =", round(nmds$stress, 3)
    ),
    x = "NMDS1",
    y = "NMDS2",
    colour = "Year"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

fig_nmds
```
